zebra.phase_definition: phase = asin(r.a)/period, r = reflected view ray, a = stripe axis (in the image plane); light/dark changes at half-integer... integer multiples of 0.5
zebra.sampled_region: both cut edges from the LE point to the TE corners (u in [1e-5, 1], dense near both ends); visible points only (n.e > 0.05) and |r.a| < 0.999
